title: QoffeeAutomat hub shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the hub schemas: enrollment, the hub link extensions config_sync and mgmt_tunnel, and the fleet link (PLAN.md S20, task T901). Field names are snake_case like all QoffeeLink frames.

agent_id.description: The stable id of an agent (the same constraint as agent_info.id of S07).

request_id.description: Integer id chosen by the sender of a request (S07).

document_kind.description: Kind of a hub document in config_sync (S20).

document_id.description: Id of a hub document: a command, sensor or mode id, the file name of a script, or any other identifier that is unique for its kind.

sha256_hex.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256: of the canonical JSON of a document body, for scripts of the UTF-8 text (S20).

signature.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, with padding) of the 64 byte ECDSA P-256 signature in IEEE P1363 form (r followed by s) over the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {agent_id, generation, policy, items} (S20, D-027).

public_key.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, with padding) of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of an ECDSA P-256 public key (91 bytes).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of a TLS certificate: 32 upper-case hex bytes separated by colons.

hub_url.description: Base URL of the hub, for example https://hub.example.org:8490.

enrollment_token.description: One-time or limited-use token created in the hub UI (base64url characters).

credential.description: Per-agent credential: 32 random bytes as base64url without padding.

generation.description: Generation of the desired state of one agent; increases per agent, the first one is 1.

applied_generation.description: The last applied generation; 0 means that no generation was applied yet.

policy.description: The effective policy of an agent (D-029). The hub resolves 'inherit' before it signs.

document_ref.description: Names a document without its content.

desired_item.description: An entry of the signed item list: a document and its hash.

hub_document.description: A document with its body. The body of a script is the script text, the body of every other kind is a JSON object in the agent's document format (S06); variables is an object of name to string.

variables_body.description: Body of a variables document: key/value pairs exposed to every run as QA_HUBVAR_<NAME> environment variables, never spliced into text (S20, D-012).

config_item_result.description: Outcome of one document in config_status.

tunnel_role.description: Role of the hub user on whose behalf a tunnelled request is made (S20).

principal.description: The hub user behind a tunnelled request; the agent writes it to its audit log.

api_path.description: A path of the agent's management API (S08). It must start with /api/v1/ and carries no query string or fragment; the agent additionally rejects dot segments and encoded separators.

stream_id.description: Id of a tunnelled Server-Sent-Events stream, chosen by the agent.

power_state.description: The last bye reason (S07) of an agent, or unknown.

hub_info.description: Identity of a hub, in the fleet hello.

agent_entry.description: An agent as listed by get_agents. manifest_rev and agent are absent for an agent that never connected.

hub_error_code.description: Error codes that the hub adds to the codes of S07 (S20). revoked is only used in the HTTP response of the agent link (status 401).

config_desired_result_data.description: Data of the result of config_desired: the documents the agent lacks.

mgmt_request_result_data.description: Data of the result of mgmt_request: the HTTP status and body of the tunnelled API call.

body.description: Any JSON value; absent when the response has no body.

mgmt_stream_open_result_data.description: Data of the result of mgmt_stream_open.

get_agents_result_data.description: Data of the result of get_agents, limited to the scope of the token.
